goal: Move DC-Agent watchdog rules out of ad hoc shell blocks into a testable engine while preserving the existing cron entrypoint.

acceptance_criteria.description: The active probe registry is defined in a Python watchdog engine and dc-watchdog.sh consumes it instead of hard-coding the service list.
Agent maintenance suppression ignores long-lived Codex desktop app-server processes but still recognizes recent or workspace-scoped Codex/Claude CLI processes.
watchdogctl reports probe enabled/disabled state from the same engine registry as dc-watchdog.sh.

When NAS owns the assistant runtime, the Mac watchdog probes the NAS health endpoint with restart grace for transient failures, disables local AstrBot probes, and the safe restart command cannot silently launch a duplicate local AstrBot instance.
